name: Can structural remodeling increase my home's value?

mainEntity.name: Can structural remodeling increase my home's value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, structural remodeling can significantly increase your home's value, especially when it addresses fundamental issues or enhances functionality. Projects like strengthening a compromised foundation, adding usable living space through an addition, or creating an open-concept layout by removing load-bearing walls are highly valued by buyers. These improvements not only make the home safer and more modern but also improve its overall appeal and marketability. It's an investment that typically yields a strong return, particularly in competitive markets like Beverly Hills or Santa Monica.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, structural remodeling can significantly increase home value by addressing issues, adding space, or improving layouts, making the home safer, more modern, and marketable.
